_what: Everything a member swaps to rebuild this look on their own take. transcribe.py, cut.py and build.py all read it. Every value below is an EXAMPLE showing the shape: Claude fills it from the member's own take before each build.
_keep_note: Source-second ranges to keep, in order (example values). Cut points go in measured pauses, never through a word.
_fixes_note: fixes: wrong word -> right word (as whisper wrote it). time_fixes: "text@whisper_start" -> the real onset in source seconds, for a word whisper put early. Both start empty.
_hook_note: 1-2 short lines in the member's own words, caps. hook_accent_word must be one of the hook's words exactly; it gets the highlight colour.
_caption_groups_note: [first word index, last word index] from the word list cut.py prints. 1-3 words a group, break at commas and pauses. Example values.
_keywords_note: Words (caps, as they appear in the captions) that pop harder. Pick the member's own stressed words.
_zoom_plan_note: [word index, scale]: alternate 1.0 / 1.18 on phrase starts, ONE 1.3 on the biggest line. Example values.
_layout_note: caption_top and zoom_origin_y follow the member's chin (y px on the 1080x1920 frame). These suit a close-up with the chin at ~1420.
_sfx_note: [id, file in assets/sfx/, seconds into the file where it peaks, duration, volume]. Not shipped: if the file isn't there it is skipped. Measure your own file's peak (npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.83 audio --json).
_hero_words_note: One word (caps) that sits alone in its own caption group and gets a bigger size, with the 1.3 punch-in.
